Person-derived and population-column variables

Source: R/lang_v2.R
omop_age.Rd

Helpers that return ready variables (their name is taken from the list element name in omop_recipe(variables = list(age = omop_age())), or a default).

Usage

omop_age(
  reference = c("index", "today"),
  year = NULL,
  reference_date = NULL,
  bands = FALSE,
  age_breaks = NULL
)

omop_sex()

omop_race()

omop_ethnicity()

omop_birth_year_band(width = 5)

omop_died(before = NULL)

omop_days_to_death()

omop_n_observation_periods()

omop_obs_duration(period_policy = c("total", "first", "last", "longest"))

omop_prior_obs(reference_date)

omop_followup(reference_date)

omop_observed_days(window)

omop_score(type, reference_date = NULL)

omop_population_column(
  name = c("index_source", "set_id", "is_case", "sampling_weight")
)

Arguments

reference

"index" or "today" (today's date is recorded at construction so executions stay reproducible).

year

Optional reference year (shorthand for reference_date).

reference_date

Optional fixed ISO reference date.

bands

Logical; legacy age_group bands.

age_breaks

NULL or integer band lower bounds starting at 0.

width

Birth-year band width (years).

before

Optional day offset: died before index + before.

period_policy

Observation-duration policy.

window

An omop_window() for omop_observed_days().

type

Score type.

name

Population column: "index_source", "set_id", "is_case" or "sampling_weight".

Value

An omop_variable.

Details

omop_age() is the annual age (reference year minus year of birth) at the index date (or today / a fixed reference_date or year); bands = TRUE gives the legacy age_group on the server's default grid or on age_breaks (any strictly increasing integer lower bounds starting at 0). Exact age and exact birth components are ordinary quasi-identifier columns on assign paths (released only through the final minimum-persons rule). omop_score() computes a comorbidity score (charlson, chads2, chadsvasc, dcsi, hfrs) over conditions on or before the reference date (the index when NULL).

Examples

omop_age(); omop_age(bands = TRUE, age_breaks = c(0, 18, 65))
omop_score("charlson"); omop_observed_days(omop_window(-365, 0))
